additionalDescription: Automation should feel empowering, not intimidating. We designed Streamline with non-technical users in mind, using visual metaphors and natural language descriptions that make complex workflows accessible. The goal was to give everyone superpowers.
highlights: Built a visual workflow editor with drag-and-drop simplicity
Created 200+ pre-built integrations with popular business tools
Implemented conditional logic and branching for complex workflows
Designed a monitoring dashboard with detailed execution logs
